turn_text: This is the Missouri Military Minute.
I'm Ashley Bird. Missouri's U.S. Senator Josh Hawley is calling for the resignation of military leaders in the wake of the evacuation of Afghanistan, but he says he appreciates those who served.

I've heard from so many veterans over the last month who, looking at those pictures of Afghanistan, looking at the total chaos and collapse over there at this administration's withdrawal, I mean it has just been sickening to them and for many of them it's been really, really hard to take and I just want to say to them thank you for your noble service to our country, and thank you for doing your duty, which you were asked to do day in and day out. But I'd say again, that does not absolve the leadership, the political leadership, and we're appropriate the military leadership of actually being accountable for what has happened in the last month, and also what's happened in the last 20 years. We've got to learn from this, and I think one of the things we have to learn is that nation building, which is what ultimately our mission evolved into, is a mistake.
